title: Reduce all-class rank-seven COPY from 41832 to 196 ordinary adapters
body:
This follow-up to #3950 replaces its alternate full SL64 conjugator by a projector chart and fixed permutation networks. The complete emitted invoice drops from 41,832 ADD slots per column plus 41,832 ordinary interchanges to **8,036 ADD slots per column plus 196 ordinary interchanges**, surrounding one reversed 7f child. This is a uniform algebraic construction and a **conditional relative cost theorem**, not a physical supplier admission or a new exponent.

The construction works for every split rank-seven projector over Z/q^w and arbitrary diagonal ancestor units. A unit principal chart exists by the characteristic-polynomial coefficient identity. One-hot pivot triples regroup into stars; on the chart, `L_(CA^-1) U_(-B)` supplies the image/kernel conjugator. The head needs only seven explicit image-weight diagonal factors, compensated at one kernel hub. Fixed routing pays 84 ordinary calls for pivots, 56 for graph passes and 56 for the diagonal, including both banks, inverse words and routing back. Equal physical prefix labels remain distinct; no conditional physical permutation or clean-data restriction is assumed.

The full relative invoice is `T_R(v,7f,w)+196 b(v,f)+C_q v(8036f+196+3)+gamma`, plus the actual63 XOR readers and outer production/owner/return charges when not already billed. Copying, releases, disposal, metadata preparation and visited backing remain explicit. The positive ordinary term still cannot be absorbed using the pinned B1/B2 upper tariffs at R437 scaling. Reducing its constant does not change that exponent gap. This is not a runtime lower bound or an objection to the original good/fallback caller.

Actual optimized Git-free read-only export succeeds; five altered/missing/linked-source or stale/typed-invoice CLI controls reject. These are separate implementations in one assisted session, not independent human or formal-kernel review.
